title: Support of an ordinary affine module identified with restricted cohomology
statement: Let X be a scheme with the derived categories of module sheaves and over-sites [def-pc-derived-category], f a compatible global section [def-sc-derived-global-scalar], Eprime a quasi-coherent derived object with cohomology stalks zero outside V(f), U an affine open, k and i integers, and N a module over Gamma(U,O). If affinePerfectSheafification(N) [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model] is isomorphic to the i-th homology of derived over-site restriction of Eprime[k], then D(f|U) is disjoint from Module.support Gamma(U,O) N.

proof.text: Apply the inverse over-site equivalence to the given sheaf isomorphism and compose with exact restriction/homology comparison and overFunctorEquiv. This gives an isomorphism from chart restriction of tilde N to open restriction of H^i(Eprime[k]). The homology shiftIso identifies this with H^(k+i)(Eprime).

For a prime p in D(f|U), take y=isoSpec.inv(p). Section compatibility f.property and Scheme.basicOpen_res, together with fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen, imply y.val is outside global V(f). The given support makes the stalk of H^(k+i)(Eprime) there zero. Apply restrictStalkNatIso to the sheaf isomorphism and chart inverse identity to get a zero stalk of tilde N at p. Its localization property and IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff give annihilators in the prime complement for every element. LocalizedModule.subsingleton_iff and Module.notMem_support_iff now show p is not in support.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_restricted_homology_support
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (f : RingCat.sectionsSubring (X.sheaf.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat.{u}))
    (E' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (hSupport : ∀ (i : ℤ) (x : X), x ∉ X.zeroLocus (U := ⊤) {f.val (op ⊤)} →
      Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E'.obj).val.presheaf x)))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (k : ℤ)
    (i : ℤ) (N : ModuleCat.{u} (X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)))
    (hN : Nonempty ((affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).obj N ≅
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) i).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (E'.obj⟦k⟧)))) :
    Disjoint (↑(PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (R := (X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) : Type u))
      (f.val (op U)))) (Module.support (X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) N)
